honesty_check:
Mostly honest on facts, badly over-confident on odds, and it broke its own rule three times.

VERIFIED TRUE (credit where due): every verbatim quote I checked was real. "Experience 0 to 2 years / Qualification: BE/BTech, MBA (Finance) or CA" is on req 1384841600 exactly as claimed. "Experience 0-3 years / Qualification: Any Graduation" is on 1357555200 exactly as claimed. The Business Analyst req 1419507000 genuinely has NO Experience and NO Qualification field at all, unlike the other three - that surprising claim held up. The campus deadline "11:55pm, Wednesday 30 September 2026 (HKT)" and the final-year eligibility line are both real. No fabricated quotes, no dead links.

OVERREACH 1 - it quoted the disqualifying rule and then ignored it. The campus pages say verbatim "you can only apply to one opportunity globally per academic year." The screen flagged this between picks 1 and 2 but still served pick 7 (Finance) as a third campus option. Three campus picks is one campus pick. Two of the three were never actionable and should not have been on the list.

OVERREACH 2 - "his free Jan-May 2027 final semester" is an assumption stated as fact, and pick 2 rests entirely on it. Nobody verified DJSCE allows a nine-week Hong Kong residency during semester 8, which normally carries coursework and Apr-May end-sem exams. The screen noticed the risk in the gaps field and then scored the pick 78 anyway.

OVERREACH 3 - it read the required/desired split backwards on RSK Model Validation (1361042500). I pulled the section headers. Every item it counted as evidence (PowerBI, SQL, Flask, VSCode/Copilot, AI tooling) sits under "Desirable:". Every item he fails - "Strong unit test and debugging skills", "Basic understanding of risk models e.g. Value at Risk, Counterparty Credit Risk models, FRTB", and the Scipy/PyTorch library list - sits under "Required Qualification, Experience & Skills:". The fit case was built out of the optional column.

OVERREACH 4 - on the Business Analyst req it let one favourable ABSENCE (no years line) outweigh five stated REQUIREMENTS. He fails 5 of 8 bullets in a section literally headed "Mandatory Skill Set". A missing experience field is an HR omission, not an invitation to freshers.

OVERREACH 5 - scoring eligibility as if it were probability. 82 for an HK graduate programme is not defensible for an Indian-university candidate with no HK work rights against an AEJ pool recruiting largely from HK/SG target schools. The posting is silent on visa sponsorship - the screen asserted "they do for this programme" without a source.

MATERIAL OMISSION - I enumerated all 44 opportunities on the campus board: London, Paris, Milan, Madrid, Frankfurt, Zurich, Hong Kong, Singapore, San Francisco. ZERO in India. The screen never said that the campus route means leaving the country, full stop. It also missed the one India-based 2027-batch route that exists: nomura.com/india/careers hosts a Global Markets Quant Challenge, eligibility "Graduating Batch of 2027 (B. Tech and Dual Degree), Streams: All branches", explicitly offering "a PPI (pre-placement interview) or a PPO (pre-placement offer)". That is his batch, his degree, a competition format he has won 13 times, and it leads to a Mumbai offer. Caveat I verified myself: the Register Now button is HTML-commented out, so this cycle's registration is closed - but gmquantchallenge@nomura.com is still live on the page and is a free email to send.
final_recommendation: File the 2027 Risk Management Graduate Program (Hong Kong, opp 1483) this week and treat it as his single, irreversible Nomura campus application for the year - the posted bar is "final year of study, available to commence July 2027," he meets both clauses literally, and it is the only pick here whose eligibility survived a hostile read. Submit by 27 Sep at the latest against the verified 11:55pm HKT 30 September 2026 deadline, write availability as "available to commence July 2027" in their exact words, and do NOT touch opp 1488, 1526 or any other campus opportunity, because "you can only apply to one opportunity globally per academic year" is real and filing anywhere else burns this. In parallel, since campus means leaving India entirely (44 opportunities, zero in India), run the Mumbai track by referral only: have a DJSCE alum at Powai internally submit him against OPS-PM/CBIT-Metrics (req 11008, 0-3 years, "Any Graduation" - the most structurally passable req Nomura India has posted) and Product Management IWM (0-2 years, BE/BTech explicitly accepted), with the ask framed not as "hire me now" but "can this headcount take a Jan-May 2027 Powai intern with June 2027 conversion." Send one free email to gmquantchallenge@nomura.com asking whether the Global Markets Quant Challenge has another round open for the 2027 batch - it is India-based, his exact batch and degree, and carries a stated PPO. Skip the Business Analyst and Model Validation reqs entirely; both fail multiple explicitly mandatory bullets and will be filtered before a human reads them.

verified_picks.title: 2027 Risk Management Graduate Program – Hong Kong (opp 1483) / Singapore (opp 1482)
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (deep link, verified). NOTE: the URL the screen supplied was https://nomuracampus.tal.net/.../candidate/jobboard/vacancy/1/adv/ which also returns 200 but is the generic 'Student Opportunities' board listing all 44 programmes, NOT this posting. Link-quality defect: it reused that same generic URL for pick 7. I substituted the real opp/1483 deep link above.
verified_picks.reason: SURVIVES. I fetched the posting. Eligibility verbatim: 'We welcome diversity in our teams and would encourage students from all background and disciplines who are in your final year of study (and be available to commence in July 2027) to apply.' He is in his final year (Aug 2023–May 2027) and July 2027 is his first available full-time month — both clauses met literally, no years-of-experience bar, no degree filter, no credential demand. Deadline confirmed verbatim: 'Please apply before 11:55pm, Wednesday 30 September 2026 (HKT)' — six days out. Also confirmed verbatim, and this is the single most important line in the whole company: 'Please note that you can only apply to one opportunity globally per academic year.' Score trimmed 82→72 because the screen priced posted-eligibility as if it were odds. Three things it did not tell him: (1) I enumerated all 44 campus opportunities — London, Paris, Milan, Madrid, Frankfurt, Zurich, HK, SG, San Francisco, and ZERO in India, so the campus route is emigration, not a Mumbai job; (2) the posting is completely silent on visa sponsorship and right to work in Hong Kong — the screen's claim that Nomura sponsors 'for this programme' is unsourced; (3) an Indian-university candidate is an outlier in an AEJ pool drawn mainly from HK/SG and regional target schools. Eligible is not the same as likely. Still the correct single bet: it is a direct full-time analyst offer with a July 2027 start, it needs no exception to his graduation date, and risk analytics is on his own wants list.

verified_picks.title: 2027 Global Markets Graduate Internship Program – Hong Kong (opp 1488) / Singapore (opp 1487)
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED on three grounds, none of them about the posted text — which I confirmed is accurate (final-year students, nine weeks from around February 2027, 'commence for Graduate Analyst Program by July 2027', same 30 Sep 2026 deadline). FIRST: I confirmed verbatim on this very page 'you can only apply to one opportunity globally per academic year.' Filing this forfeits the Risk Management programme. The comparison is then a nine-week audition with explicit conversion risk versus a direct full-time offer — and the screen's own numbers rank Risk higher (82 vs 78). Dominated. SECOND: the pick rests entirely on 'his free Jan-May 2027 final semester', which nobody verified. DJSCE semester 8 runs Jan-May and normally carries coursework plus Apr-May end-semester exams; a nine-week Hong Kong residency Feb-Apr collides head-on with it. The screen listed this as a gap and then scored the pick 78 anyway. If DJSCE says no, the pick is worth zero — and he would have burned his one application to find out. THIRD: it contradicts his stated wants. Global Markets is a sales/trading/structuring floor. He asked for business analyst, BI, data analyst, analytics, strategy and product ops. The screen bridged this by telling him to 'name Research', which is coaching him to misrepresent his interest to a desk he has never worked on. Do not spend the one application here.

verified_picks.title: Product Management — Analyst, Lending & Credit Solutions business transformation (IWM), Mumbai
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (verified live; title tag 'Product Management Job Details | Nomura Holdings, inc.', no expiry or 'no longer available' marker, Apply now button present)
verified_picks.reason: SURVIVES on qualifications, fails on timing. I pulled the req body and both headline claims are exactly right: 'Experience / 0 to 2 years' and 'Qualification / BE/BTech, MBA (Finance) or CA'. B.Tech is explicitly named and no MBA or CA is required — this is the only Mumbai req in the set with a genuine zero floor AND an engineering degree accepted. Skills check out too: 'Data Visualization skills in PowerBI, Tableau or similar tools' is already satisfied by his PowerBI (do not let him waste weeks on Tableau for this), and 'Programming skills in Excel Macro, VBA, Python, SQL+' gives him two of four named. The real holes are 'Proficiency in Excel, Visio, JIRA & Confluence' where he has one of four, and Excel Macro/VBA — and the screen was right that these are genuinely cheap to close in about four weeks, unlike domain knowledge. Score cut 74→62 for the blocker the screen soft-pedalled: this is an immediate-joiner requisition and he cannot start full-time for roughly nine months. Nomura Mumbai experienced-hire reqs do not hold headcount that long. A cold application here is near-certain silence. Keep it — a careers.nomura.com application costs him nothing (the one-per-year rule applies only to the campus system, not this one) — but its only real value is as a referral target, and the ask a referrer should make is 'can this headcount absorb a Jan-May 2027 Powai intern', not 'please hire this person now'.

verified_picks.title: Business Analyst — Wholesale Data Services & Operations Technology, Mumbai
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (verified live, real posting, Apply now button present)
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED. The screen's headline claim is factually correct and I want to be fair about that: I diffed this req against the other three Mumbai postings and it genuinely has NO Experience field and NO Qualification field, where the others print 'Experience 0 to 2 years', '0-3 years', '1-4 years'. That absence is real. It is also not worth what the screen paid for it. I pulled the full requirement list. The section is headed 'Mandatory Skill Set :' and has eight bullets. He fails five of them outright: 'Proficiency in requirements management tools (JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps' — he has none of the three; 'Understanding of financial markets, trading instruments, and order lifecycles'; 'Knowledge of regulatory frameworks (MiFID II, Dodd-Frank, Basel III)'; 'Familiarity with trade lifecycle (pre-trade, execution, post-trade, settlement)'; and 'Experience creating test scenarios and conducting UAT' — he has never run a UAT cycle. Mandatory means required. The screen let one favourable omission outweigh five stated requirements, which is exactly backwards: a missing experience field on a req whose mandatory list assumes regulatory and trade-lifecycle fluency is an HR oversight, not an opening for a fresher. Two further points it never mentioned: the posting's own Skill Category is 'IT\Technology', so this is a technology BA embedded with traders and not the analytics BA he wants, and the screen's proposed fix (NISM Series-VIII, three weeks) buys vocabulary on two bullets while leaving UAT and the regulatory bullet untouched. Immediate-joiner as well. Do not spend the effort.

verified_picks.title: OPS-PM / CBIT-Metrics — Analyst, Front Office & Operations MI / reporting (Requisition No. 11008), Mumbai
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (verified live, real posting, Apply now button present)
verified_picks.reason: SURVIVES, and it is the most structurally passable India req he has. Verified verbatim: 'Experience / 0-3 years' and 'Qualification / Any Graduation' — no degree filter of any kind, the loosest education bar in the set. I then checked the Mandatory-versus-Desired split, because that is where the screen got another req wrong, and here it got it right. The MANDATORY technical bullets are '0-2 years' experience in designing reports in SAP Business Objects or other reporting tools' and 'Expertise in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Python etc.' — he hits all four named tools on the second bullet (Excel, PowerPoint via the Infiheal Series A deck, PowerBI, Python), and 'or other reporting tools' on the first is a real escape hatch his PowerBI dashboards and funnel-tracking work can fill. The brutal asks the screen worried about — 'Expert knowledge on SAP Business Objects Web Rich Client Report development', Design Studio, Lumira — all sit in the DESIRED column, not mandatory. Mandatory domain asks '0-3 Years' Experience in Financial Services', and CypherSOL (fintech, bank-statement analysis, Dec 2025–Feb 2026) is defensible inside a band that starts at zero. One honest caution the screen also raised and I endorse: the divisional overview says the team 'is expected to possess strong technical skills especially in Business Objects', so SAP BO matters more culturally than the mandatory wording implies. Score essentially held. Two real caveats: immediate-joiner req, so referral is still required to bridge nine months; and it is an MI/reporting seat rather than analytics with judgement attached — a step below his ambition, worth taking as a foot in the door, not as the goal.

verified_picks.title: RSK-Model Validation Group (Analyst/Associate — Python analytics & model testing library), Mumbai
verified_picks.http_status: 200 (verified live, real posting, Apply now button present)
verified_picks.reason: REFUTED, and the screen's fit case was assembled from the wrong column. I extracted the section headers. Everything it cited as evidence sits under 'Desirable:' — 'Experience with a reporting tool e.g. PowerBI', 'Experience with SQL', 'Experience with VSCode and Github copilot', 'Knowledge of programming AI tools in Python', 'Experience with the Python Flask framework'. Every bullet he fails sits under 'Required Qualification, Experience & Skills:' — 'Strong unit test and debugging skills' (there is no testing evidence anywhere on his resume or in any of the four projects, and a model-validation team will probe precisely this), 'Basic understanding of risk models e.g. Value at Risk, Counterparty Credit Risk models, FRTB or derivative pricing' (he has none; Computational Finance coursework is not this), and the required stack line naming 'Numpy, Scipy, Pandas, Matplotlib, sci-kit-learn PyTorch.and SQLAlchemy' — SciPy and PyTorch are both absent and ONNX is not a substitute. The opening required line is 'Very experienced, and deep understanding of Python', which is not a description of a final-year student. Separately, the posted band is 'Experience / 1-4 years' and his ~13 months are internships, not professional experience; the recruiter screens that field first and internships do not count against it. The SQLAlchemy hit is genuinely unusual and the screen was right to notice it, but one desirable-column match does not offset three required-column misses plus a years bar. The proposed fix — a weekend of pytest plus three weeks of VaR reading — closes two required bullets on paper and would not survive the first technical question. Do not apply, cold or referred.

Keep false.
